rows.summary: Causal-guided adaptive knowledge editing (CAKE) provides a mechanism for localizing and adjusting foundational premises in LLMs. By mapping causal dependencies, agents can potentially prune or refine erroneous axioms that propagate through reasoning chains. This methodology is particularly relevant for addressing foundational assumptions that are not explicitly defined but implicitly govern agent behavior.
